description_en: Modifies the information about the endpoint of an instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS集群系列实例的Endpoint连接地址信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-endpoint-address --db-instance-id rm-0000 --db-instance-endpoint-id ep-0000 --connection-string rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints operation to query the endpoint ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的Endpoint ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints查询
parameters.name: db_instance_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint that you want to modify. The endpoint can be a public endpoint or an internal endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的实例某个连接地址，可以是内网或外网连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the internal endpoint
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the internal endpoint
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the internal endpoint
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the new endpoint. You can modify only the prefix of the endpoint that is specified by the ConnectionString parameter
parameters.help_zh: 目标连接地址的前缀。只能修改ConnectionString参数的前缀部分
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The port number of the new endpoint
parameters.name: port

DBInstanceEndpointId.description_en: The endpoint ID of the instance
